snippet.title: SkyInFlames // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4031360/SkyInFlames

Command drones, deploy mobile air defense systems and conduct tactical aerial operations. Choose your side - Ukrainian or Russian forces - and protect critical infrastructure in a realistic military simulation on a detailed map.

👥 Players: Single Player, Online Co-op, Online PvP
🛠️ Developer: VasyliyBritva
📚 Publisher: VasyliyBritva
📅 Release Date: Apr 28, 2026 to Early Access
🎯 Genre: Strategy, Early Access


AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:
The graphic shows images of units (actions) that are created on the basis of real software features to change development time. Additionally, some functionality was ported from a raw state and refined using AI, and AI is also being used to write several of the core systems. (In the trailer, we also used some AI-generated audio and images.)

Mature Content Description
The developers describe the content like this:
This game contains military themes and simulated warfare. Intended for mature audiences.
